integrity: Analytical orbit proof with exact polynomial monotonicity certificates; exact-rational full-graph tests provide independent finite cross-checks. Scientific novelty is literature-dependent and not independently audited.
limitations: Canonical real Euclidean-orthogonal projections only; unweighted rank-three Kneser graphs, \(n\ge7\); no minimality among arbitrary projections, p-intermediate bounds, or general ranks.
title: Separated sharp dimension peaks for cut–cycle endpoint norms of rank-three Kneser graphs
